remarks: Single-story living in Mission Viejo’s Deane Homes neighborhood—with the opportunity to make it your own. Located at 24715 San Andres Lane, this 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers 1,508 square feet on a 5,000-square-foot lot in one of Mission Viejo’s original neighborhoods. If you’ve been searching for a single-level home in South Orange County, this is a chance to start with a well-cared-for property and bring your own vision to it. The home is dated and needs updates and some additional work, giving you the freedom to choose the finishes, improvements, and layout changes that matter most to you.
